rules.cash: Sell to cash; useful when expected gains fail to cover trading costs or risk.
rules.hold: Keep existing units; avoids paying for an unnecessary rebalance.
rules.buy_hold: Target full funded exposure, with no leverage.
rules.sma_trend: Target exposure when trailing 50-day mean exceeds 200-day mean.
rules.price_trend: Target exposure when the known close exceeds its trailing 200-day mean.
rules.donchian_breakout: Enter above the prior 20-day high; retain until below the prior 10-day low.
rules.rsi_pullback: Enter an oversold pullback within an uptrend; exit on RSI recovery or trend failure.
rules.bollinger_revert: Enter below two trailing standard deviations; retain until the trailing mean recovers.
rules.bullish_engulf: Enter after a bullish real body engulfs the prior bearish body, above the 50-day mean.
rules.hammer_rebound: Enter after a green candle with a long lower wick during a trailing seven-day decline.
rules.risk_scaled_trend: Reduce funded exposure as trailing volatility increases, inside the price trend.
